title: mentha arvensis subsp. fontana
intro: Mentha arvensis subsp. fontana, commonly known as American wild mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant. It is a perennial herb native to North America, known for its distinctive minty aroma and flavor. American wild mint has been used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties.
